notes.heading: Frame
notes.text: The J1 axis is +Z through the origin, and z = 0 is the mounting face the Base Mounting Plate bolts to. Every arm carries gussets (G1): one on the centre of each ±X arm, two at the sides of each ±Y arm; the windows (W1) and strake slots (K1) sit at 30° + 60°k, between the tower's six columns. This is the bolted v9 part exported from dde/HDIMeterModel.gltf; the onshape KP0001 STEP is the un-bolted predecessor and is not a source. Toggle the section cut to look at the floor (R1) and the hub (B2, H2).

notes.heading: Comparing
notes.text: Toggle the reference against either render. The previous render is the dist-gated recreation, so it should hide the mesh entirely. The revised render opens H1 and its counterbore by the slip clearance, and trims R1's twelve z 24.000 plateaus beside the hub holes to the floor around them (Floor plateaus preset). The dimensions and fits are in 110-001_BaseMountBottom.scad's header. Run render.rs --verify before building this page, because the renders are its output.
